fieldNotes.truckGate: Open industrial-park setting. The facility fronts directly onto N Reach Rd / internal industrial-park streets with no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point at any approach. Trucks drive straight into the drop yards from the public road.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible. A small fenced/landscaped structure on the north side appears to be a site utility/break building, not a gate booth.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Open paved approach directly off the road; no deep gated queue lane.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Multiple rows of parked trailers in drop yards wrapping the north and east sides of the building; ~55 trailers visible, capacity ~80.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors along the south/east building faces partly obscured by parked trailers and trees; estimate ~22 in the 10-25 band.
fieldNotes.railServed: An active rail line runs through the eastern part of the property, with rail tank cars and trailers parked beside it.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located within the Williamsport, PA industrial fabric — dense surrounding industrial development; classed Urban.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main plant/DC building plus the silo/process structure cluster on the SE; counted as 2.
